instruction: I have motor difficulties and struggle with keyboard shortcuts that require multiple keys. Please enable sticky keys so I can press modifier keys one at a time.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: STICKY_KEYS=$(timeout 10 gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.keyboard sticky-keys-enable 2>/dev/null | grep -c true); if [ "$STICKY_KEYS" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Sticky keys enabled"; else echo "Sticky keys not enabled"; fi

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling sticky keys via Settings > Accessibility > Typing Assist > Sticky Keys. Evaluator checks sticky-keys-enable setting. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_command_line getter.
